entity.name: Pacific Community Statistics for Development Division (SDD)

lineage.description: Census population data from Tonga's 2016 census was spatially gridded at 1km resolution and intersected with coastal buffer zones (1km inland from shoreline) to quantify populations in coastal proximity. Administrative block boundaries and household counts were used to distribute population across spatial units for coastal vulnerability assessment.
